thread:
Alice (PM): Quick sync — 'concertina' initiative: we need to compress scope to meet Q3 launch. Major deps: runtime batching change, infra rolling capacity, security HSM gating. Can we map cut candidates and impact?
Ben (Runtime): I can sketch perf numbers. The batching patch reduces p95 by ~30% but needs a shader change + testing on A100 V5s. ETA ~3w to validate.
Carla (Infra): Dedicated pool for the pilot can be ready in 2w if we commit GPUs. Need a formal capacity ticket and cost approval. If we wait for autoscale rules, add 1 week.
Diego (Security): HSM/KMS change requires a short threat model + key rotation plan. Also need compliance signoff for private deploys. Estimate 2 sprints unless we scope it down.
Evan (EngSRE): Prewarm behavior is the wildcard — if we change batching we should simulate tail traffic. I'll add synthetic workload and baseline dashboard. Need addl 1 day for probes but 5 days for burn-in.
Fiona (Design): UX changes are minimal; we can hide advanced options and ship default flow. That cuts surface area.
Alice (PM): OK. Proposal: produce a 2-column triage matrix (keep/cut) with owners and acceptance criteria by EOD Wednesday. I'll draft and post.
Ben (Runtime): Cut candidate: multi-quant per-tenant configs. Costly to validate; low visible value for MVP. Recommend postpone.
Carla (Infra): Cut candidate: global autoscale burst toggle. We can instead reserve a small warm pool for pilot; cheaper to commit upfront.
Diego (Security): For HSM gating: alternative is to use KMS-only path for pilot and add HSM later. That reduces compliance risk but changes SLA wording.
Evan (EngSRE): Fallback plan: if batch change causes tail regressions, route 10% traffic to legacy runtime for 72h and monitor. I'll own the rollout job.
Alice (PM): Acceptance criteria (draft): 1) p95 <= 600ms on pilot workload; 2) fallbacks in place; 3) infra commit + cost approval; 4) security attestation or KMS-only fallback.
Ben (Runtime): I'll produce perf numbers + experiment plan by Tue.
Carla (Infra): I'll open ticket infra#4427 and request capacity commit. I'll link cost estimate.
Diego (Security): I'll do a lightweight threat model and a mitigations doc and post to #security-review by Tue EOD.
Evan (EngSRE): I'll create observability checklist and staging playbook. Will pair with Ben for synthetic tests.
Fiona (Design): I'll prepare microcopy and hide advanced settings behind 'advanced' toggle.
deploy-bot: deploy job concertina/pilot queued — build-1823
Alice (PM): Excellent. Action items: Ben (perf plan), Carla (infra#4427), Diego (threat model), Evan (playbook), Fiona (microcopy). We reconvene Thu 10am to lock scope. :thumbsup:
Ben (Runtime): +1
Carla (Infra): +1
Diego (Security): +1
Evan (EngSRE): +1
Fiona (Design): ✅
Alice (PM): Thanks all — posting the triage doc shortly.
